cards.text: It's the Feast of Tabernacles, and Jesus, who came up from Galilee, has been teaching in the temple courts (John 7:2, 9-10, 14). People have tried to seize Him but no one laid a hand on Him, and the chief priests and Pharisees have sent officers to arrest Him (John 7:30, 32). Now it's the last and greatest day of the feast.
Jesus stands up and calls out in a loud voice, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to Me and drink.”

cards.question: Jesus says streams of living water will flow from within someone. Who?
The Gospel of John explains it for us. When Jesus talks about living water, He's speaking about the ___.

cards.text: Those who believed in Jesus were later to receive the Spirit. The Gospel says the Spirit “had not yet been given, because Jesus had not yet been glorified.”
Some people hear those words and say, “This is truly the Prophet.” Friend, ONE loud invitation and folks are already handing out titles.

cards.question: Some in the crowd call Jesus the Prophet. Others give a different answer. Who do they say He is?
Still others in the crowd push back. They ask how the Christ could come from one place. Which place?

cards.text: They point to Scripture: doesn't it say the Christ will come from the line of King David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David lived? Somebody in that crowd has been reading their Scriptures, friend, and I respect it.

cards.question: Jesus' words leave the crowd divided because of Him.
When some in the crowd want to seize Jesus this time, someone lays a hand on Him.

cards.text: Now the officers head back to the chief priests and Pharisees with nothing in their hands, like showing up to the meeting without the ONE thing you were sent to get. The bosses ask, “Why didn’t you bring Him in?”

cards.question: The chief priests and Pharisees want to know why the officers didn't bring Jesus in. What do the officers say?

answers.text: Never has anyone spoken like this man
Never has anyone drawn a crowd like this
Never has anyone stood up to us like this

cards.question: When the officers say no one has ever spoken like Jesus, the Pharisees agree with them.

cards.text: The Pharisees fire right back, “Have you also been deceived?” Then they ask, “Have any of the rulers or Pharisees believed in Him?”

cards.question: The Pharisees aren't done with the officers. They say the crowd that doesn't know the law is under a ___.

cards.text: Then Nicodemus speaks up, a man who had gone to Jesus earlier (John 3:1-2) and who is one of them. I bet that took some NERVE, friend.

cards.question: Nicodemus asks the group a question about their own law. What does he ask?

answers.text: Whether it convicts a man before hearing him
Whether it lets officers arrest at a feast
Whether it allows healing on the Sabbath

cards.question: Nicodemus asks whether their law convicts a man without hearing him first. The others answer by asking if he is from Galilee too.

cards.text: Then they tell him, “Look into it, and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.” Hang on to your apron, friend, because this story's still got another batch in the oven.
